name: Meeting with Lexy
source:
A hot and exciting short story about a married woman that doesn't get the love she needs from her husband anymore. She meets up with her old friend, Darius, but he is not alone, everything turns up fast, old memories emerge and all three to have fun once again like they used to do back in the old days. In the end, Darius will help Lexy to cuck her hubby and finally get her revenge on him.

[From F95zone]
translation:
这是一个热门而令人兴奋的短篇故事，讲述了一位已婚妇女不再从丈夫那里得到所需的爱的故事。她遇到了她的老朋友达流斯，但他并不孤单，一切都很快发生，旧的记忆浮现出来，三人再次像过去一样享受乐趣。最终，达流斯将帮助莱克西操她的丈夫，并最终向他复仇。

[来自F95zone]
